title: Design System: 금고은행 입찰 현황 히트맵

title.purpose: App title (h1), modal and bucket headings — the largest text in the product (14px).

body.purpose: Default UI text at 13px; body carries font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums globally.

control.purpose: Buttons, inputs, tabs, filter labels, ticker items (12px).

data-mono.purpose: Consolas via --mono for every figure, date, D-day, count, and code — The Tabular Ledger Rule.

caption.purpose: Badges, hints, timestamps (11px); mono when numeric.

micro-label.purpose: 10px letter-spaced muted strip titles (기관 분류선택, 입찰 임박도).

shadows.name: popover-float
shadows.purpose: The single elevation shadow in the system — #popover above the map only (The Flat Board Rule).

shadows.name: ring-state
shadows.purpose: Zero-blur ring for current/selected/gate states; an outline, not elevation. Orange variant for gates.

shadows.name: watch-glow
shadows.purpose: SVG glow on watched-region outlines; a signal, not elevation.

shadows.name: modal-scrim
shadows.purpose: Overlay scrim behind angular modal boxes.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Default hover/state transition on buttons, cards, tabs.

motion.name: ripple-duration
motion.purpose: Shared period for selection ripple rings (three rings phase-offset by thirds) and municipality outline blink; user-tunable 1–4s via theme modal, written by render.applyTheme().

motion.name: fly-zoom
motion.purpose: Drill-in geometric zoom to a region (render.ZOOM_MS).

motion.name: zoom-hold
motion.purpose: Pause after zoom before switching to the region view (render.HOLD_MS).

motion.name: cloud-fade
motion.purpose: Radial cloud overlay fade during drill-in.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: ≤880px: frame unlocks (body scrolls), control strip stacks vertically, ranking ladder drops below the map, #tab-map scrolls.

components.name: Terminal Button
components.description: The only button style — flat panel-raised block, 2px corners, hairline border; hierarchy by placement, not fill.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: var(--panel2, #131a24); color: var(--fg, #dbe4ee); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #2b3646); border-radius: 2px; padding: 5px 12px; font: 12px 'Malgun Gothic', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #182130; border-color: #3c4a5e; } .ds-btn:active { background: #0b0f16; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent-color, #ffb020); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Recessed dark well with hairline border and amber caret.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--bg-well, #0a0f16); color: var(--fg, #dbe4ee); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #2b3646); border-radius: 2px; padding: 4px 8px; font: 12px 'Malgun Gothic', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; caret-color: var(--accent-color, #ffb020); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent-color, #ffb020); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Tab Strip
components.description: Header tab strip: hairline-separated flush-square tabs; active tab fills panel-raised with a 2px amber top border.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; background: #0a0e14; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #2b3646); } .ds-tab { background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #7d8896); border: none; border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #1f2733); border-top: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; padding: 9px 16px; font: 12px 'Malgun Gothic', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:last-child { border-right: 1px solid var(--line, #1f2733); } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--panel, #0d1117); color: var(--fg, #dbe4ee); } .ds-tab.ds-active { background: var(--panel2, #131a24); color: var(--fg, #dbe4ee); border-top-color: var(--accent-color, #ffb020); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: The 18% Tint Rule chip: colored text + same-color 1px border + 18% tint. Blue=done/normal, orange=gap/approval, red=none/risk.
components.html: 작성됨 미충족 미배정 D-45
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; border-radius: 2px; padding: 1px 7px; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Malgun Gothic', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; border: 1px solid; white-space: nowrap; margin-right: 4px; } .ds-ok { color: var(--blue, #2f66d8); border-color: var(--blue, #2f66d8); background: color-mix(in srgb, #2f66d8 18%, transparent); } .ds-gap { color: var(--orange, #ef7d1a); border-color: var(--orange, #ef7d1a); background: color-mix(in srgb, #ef7d1a 18%, transparent); } .ds-none { color: var(--red, #e5372e); border-color: var(--red, #e5372e); background: color-mix(in srgb, #e5372e 18%, transparent); } .ds-dday { color: var(--red, #e5372e); border-color: var(--red, #e5372e); background: transparent; font-family: Consolas, 'Cascadia Mono', monospace; }

narrative.overview: The dashboard treats treasury-bank bid tracking with the visual grammar of a Korean home-trading-system (HTS) board: urgency is the market. A near-black blue-tinted board (#07090e), hairline-gridded flat panels, and Korean market color semantics — red rises (bid imminent), blue falls (bid distant) — turn the national map into a quote board rather than an atlas. The single interactive voice is amber (#ffb020). Soft card-style admin layouts are explicitly rejected. This is an Operate-mode surface: density is deliberate — a tight 10–14px type ladder, 2px corners, 1px separations, 150ms state transitions, and tabular monospace numerals everywhere a figure appears. The system paints even the browser's own chrome, and hard product constraints carry into the visuals: closed network (system faces only), vanilla JS, DOM ids/classes coupled to the node test suite.
keyCharacteristics: Blue-black board with three-step tonal layering, no elevation shadows
Korean market urgency semantics: red=imminent ↔ blue=distant, gray=unknown
One amber interaction voice (#ffb020), runtime-themable via render.applyTheme()
Consolas tabular numerals for all data; Malgun Gothic for Korean UI text
2px corners, hairline borders, inline-SVG stroke glyphs, zero emoji in chrome

rules.name: The Korean Market Rule
rules.body: Red means imminent/rising and blue means distant/falling, per Korean securities convention. Never re-map to western green-good/red-bad, and never use the urgency hues for interaction states.

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber (#ffb020) is reserved for selection, focus, and interaction. It never encodes urgency; urgency hues never encode selection.

rules.name: The Deepened Board Rule
rules.body: Large fills (map faces) use the deepened tier; small chrome uses the bright tier. Small text set in an urgency color over dark ground is lightened with color-mix(in srgb, <band> 70–72%, #ffffff).

rules.name: The 18% Tint Rule
rules.body: Status chips are colored text + 1px same-color border + color-mix(in srgb, <band> 18%, transparent) background. Status rows use the same mix at 8–12%. Status is never a solid colored fill.

rules.name: The Variable-Name Freeze Rule
rules.body: The :root custom-property names (--bg, --panel, --panel2, --line, --line-strong, --fg, --muted, --red, --orange, --yellow, --blue, --gray, --accent-color, --ripple-duration, --mono) are load-bearing: JS-generated inline markup references them by name and render.applyTheme() writes two of them. Change values to restyle; never rename.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a figure — D-day, dates, counts, badges with numbers, the ticker — is set in --mono (Consolas) so columns of data align like a ledger.

rules.name: The Tight Ladder Rule
rules.body: The type scale is deliberately compressed to 10–14px (Operate-mode density); the flat-type-hierarchy finding is suppressed as a sanctioned exception in .impeccable/config.json. Do not introduce sizes above 14px in app chrome; use weight, color, and spacing.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows. If a state needs emphasis, use a 1px ring (box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px), a border-color change, or an 8–18% tint — never lift.

dos: Do reference tokens as var(--…) in generated markup — --accent-color and --ripple-duration change at runtime, and the five urgency bands come from render.URGENCY_COLORS (theme-merged), not from constants.
Do pass any color that originated in localStorage through render._safeColor() before interpolating it into HTML/inline styles.
Do set every figure, date, and D-day in --mono; keep 150ms transitions for hover/state; signal state with border-color and 8–18% tints.
Do sink any new large-area color toward board-black (the map tier) and keep bright hues for small chrome.
Do draw new icons as inline SVG stroke glyphs (1.2–1.4 stroke, currentColor, 12×12 grid), matching render.ICONS.
Do check dashboard/test/*.test.js before touching DOM ids, classes, or the token names — 243 node tests are coupled to them.
donts: Don't rename any :root custom property (Variable-Name Freeze Rule) or hardcode #ffb020 where var(--accent-color) belongs.
Don't introduce radii above 2px, panel shadows, gradients-as-decoration, or soft card-admin styling — the world rejects it by thesis.
Don't add external resources of any kind (fonts, CDNs, icon packages) — closed-network constraint; system faces only.
Don't use emoji in chrome, or use amber for urgency / urgency hues for selection.
Don't exceed the 10–14px chrome type ladder; hierarchy comes from weight, color, and the mono/sans split (Tight Ladder Rule).
Don't re-map the urgency semantics away from the Korean market convention (red=imminent, blue=distant).
